editorial.tldr: On Oct 11-12, Moonshot AI was reported to be negotiating a settlement with a shareholder who claims a 10.5% original stake, ahead of its planned Hong Kong IPO. On Oct 15 Anthropic told investors quarterly revenue rose nearly 50% to $16.8bn ahead of its own listing.
editorial.whats_new: Oct 27: Latent Space reports Anthropic's S-1 is public, with 1400% growth and 48% of revenue through cloud partners; Oct 31 coverage ties Google's AI Mode to a $500B market-cap drop.
editorial.why_it_matters: An S-1 gives platform teams audited figures on cloud-partner revenue share and growth, which indicate how dependent a vendor is on hyperscaler channels when you plan multi-provider fallbacks.
editorial.take_for_builders: Read the S-1's cloud-partner and compute-commitment sections before locking multi-year Anthropic spend, and keep a fallback provider for any lab whose IPO terms are unsettled.

status.detail: Anthropic's filing is reported public; Moonshot's settlement and listing remain unresolved in these sources.
